name: StorageLocation
description: A shared storage location entity for cigars (humidors) and wine (cellars, racks). Replaces module-specific location entities with a single unified record.

name.description: Name or label for this storage location

module.description: Which module this location belongs to, or shared if used by multiple

capacity_count.description: Maximum number of items (cigars or bottles) this location can hold

current_count.description: Current number of items stored in this location

target_humidity_rh.description: Target relative humidity percentage (e.g. 65 for 65% RH) — relevant for humidors

target_temp_f.description: Target storage temperature in degrees Fahrenheit

description.description: Short description of this storage location

notes.description: Free-text notes about this location (equipment, quirks, maintenance history)

created_by.description: Email of the user who created this record

created_date.description: ISO timestamp when this record was created

updated_date.description: ISO timestamp when this record was last updated
